items.title: Geordie Greep Cancels US Tour Following Sexual Misconduct Allegation
items.summary: On Thursday (Oct. 8), Geordie Greep was accused of sexual assault via flyers handed out to fans outside his Vancouver show. The flyers claimed he was a rapist and read, "You know what you did this morning Oct 8th." His set was delayed almost two hours and he performed an abbreviated without his band after making a statement. Now, Greep has canceled the rest of his US tour dates. The post Geordie Greep Cancels US Tour Following Sexual Misconduct Allegation appeared first on Stereogum .

Today, they share the sharp, exuberant new single "Wish Upon You." As always, Lily Aron's huge and expressive voice is at the center, but my favorite part is when the full-band harmonies turn into a scream just before the chorus. items.title: Mastodon Announce Vinyl Pressed With Mastodon Fossils
items.summary: Every Mastodon record has Mastodon on it, but the new pressing of Marrow Deep has mastodon in it. The Atlanta metal legends have announced a new version of their latest album featuring actual mastodon fossils. The records, which will be limited of 170 copies, were pressed at Waxworks Records with help from the University of Georgia's geology department, using "bone dust" created by grinding down a bag of fossilized mastodon teeth the band received as a gift more than two decades ago. The post Mastodon Announce Vinyl Pressed With Mastodon Fossils appeared first on Stereogum .
